messages.subject: Colouring nodes in phylomorphospace
parts:
Dear all,

I'm using the plotGMPhyloMorphoSpace function and it works great! I was only hoping to colour the tips based on grouping information I have for my species, for example clade or region etc. This is possible and easily done when plotting the tangent space, but I can't figure out how to make it work when I add my phylogenetic tree. Does anyone know how to do this?

Thanks for your help!

Sara

messages.author: 511e44c7d1e1bab0
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Colouring nodes in phylomorphospace
parts:
Sara,

please see the help file of the function for how to use the plot.param argument for modifying plotting options. For instance, if you were to use the example data used there, and assuming a grouping factor in sp.groups as below you could do something like:

data(plethspecies) 
Y.gpa<-gpagen(plethspecies$land)
sp.groups <- c(1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2)
plotGMPhyloMorphoSpace(plethspecies$phy,Y.gpa$coords, 
                 plot.param=list(t.bg=sp.groups))

Hope this helps
Antigoni
